changes.rationale: Show agreement on all displayed candidates with the first engine shaft and other engine colors in the head; preserve opacity and score-based width.
validation: Arrow helper and renderer tests; real 2/3/4-color and secondary Stockfish candidate checks.
changes.retire_when: Upstream provides equivalent tested agreement rendering; remove the custom implementation after parity review.

changes.rationale: Review a completed puzzle on the same board, remember individual engine choices, and return to training without exposing help during solving.
validation: Puzzle component and engine-toggle regressions; completion, review, stepping back and Continue Training in an isolated profile.
changes.retire_when: Upstream provides equivalent same-board review and remembered selections; remove only after native workflow parity checks.

changes.rationale: Preserve ECO/extra tags and partial dates through conversion/editing, and serialize database autosaves so newer edits are retained.
validation: Metadata and autosave regressions; migration/save/reopen against copies; compare original hashes.
changes.retire_when: Upstream preserves the same metadata and latest-edit guarantees; verify copy-based round trips before retiring.

changes.rationale: Unsupported legacy SQLite puzzle files must be preserved during discovery, rather than deleted.
validation: Legacy fixture remains byte-identical and absent from the supported list; supported puzzle discovery remains usable.
changes.retire_when: Upstream discovery preserves unsupported files or supplies a verified non-destructive migration with equivalent tests.

changes.rationale: Reserve pending UCI startup per tab/engine, cancel closed-board starts and clean up owned worker processes without changing background analysis.
validation: Ten Unix lifecycle regressions, including delayed readiness and owned worker cleanup; real two-Maia cold-start/navigation and close/quit sampling.
changes.retire_when: Upstream prevents duplicate pending startup, late resurrection and worker leaks with equivalent per-ID/per-tab and native lifecycle coverage.

changes.rationale: Opt-in maintained builds must never replace fork-only behavior through the official updater; startup is silent and manual checks open the fork release page.
validation: Startup and manual updater regressions in both distributions; merged overlay validation; paired Cargo feature, frontend environment and overlay checks before sharing a candidate.
changes.retire_when: Only after an explicit return to upstream or a reviewed trusted fork-specific update channel; retain all guards while shipping fork-only changes.
